title.value: Run a side hustle with three agents for content, email and books

introduction.value: A working parent uses three agents: one researches and drafts content, one handles client emails and books calls, one categorizes Etsy income and expenses and writes monthly summaries.

method.value: Nova gave each of three agents a narrow job with fixed boundaries. The researcher gets a niche, audience and approved sources, then returns an outline and draft. The ops agent drafts client emails in her voice and books calls around her calendar, with no calls before 9am or after 3pm. The finance agent categorizes Etsy income and expenses, flags oddities with a one-sentence reason, and writes a monthly summary. She reviews and edits the output.

outcome.value: She reports about 6-8 hours reclaimed per week. Content drops from 3-4 hours per piece to about 40 minutes of editing. No accuracy figures are given for the finance agent.

notes.value: The post doesn't name the tools or models used, so you'd have to choose your own. Her advice is to keep each agent's scope narrow, with no overlap between them.

source_text.body:
Run a side hustle with three agents for content, email and books
A working parent uses three agents: one researches and drafts content, one handles client emails and books calls, one categorizes Etsy income and expenses and writes monthly summaries.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
Nova gave each of three agents a narrow job with fixed boundaries. The researcher gets a niche, audience and approved sources, then returns an outline and draft. The ops agent drafts client emails in her voice and books calls around her calendar, with no calls before 9am or after 3pm. The finance agent categorizes Etsy income and expenses, flags oddities with a one-sentence reason, and writes a monthly summary. She reviews and edits the output.
How it went
She reports about 6-8 hours reclaimed per week. Content drops from 3-4 hours per piece to about 40 minutes of editing. No accuracy figures are given for the finance agent.
Worth knowing
The post doesn't name the tools or models used, so you'd have to choose your own. Her advice is to keep each agent's scope narrow, with no overlap between them.
Try it yourself
with
Zapier Agents
Copy prompt
Set up three agents for my [type of side business]. Agent one researches [topics] and drafts [content type] into [doc or folder]. Agent two reads client emails in [inbox], drafts replies and suggests call times from my calendar. Agent three categorizes income and expenses from [Etsy export or sheet] and writes a monthly summary. Pause and show me every email reply and calendar booking before it is sent.
Original source: https://www.aimomlab.com/2026/09/the-side-hustle-stack-i-run-with-3-ai.html

translation.body:
用三个智能体处理副业的内容、邮件和账目
一位有工作的家长使用三个智能体：一个研究并起草内容，一个处理客户邮件和预约通话，一个对Etsy收入与支出进行分类并编写月度摘要。
使用的是
自建或未具名智能体
他们做了什么
Nova给三个智能体分别分配了范围狭窄、边界固定的任务。研究智能体收到细分领域、受众和获准来源，然后返回提纲与草稿。运营智能体以她的语气起草客户邮件，并围绕她的日历安排通话，不在上午9点之前或下午3点之后安排通话。财务智能体对Etsy收入和支出分类，用一句话解释标出的异常，并编写月度摘要。她会审核并编辑输出。
进展与成效
她说每周大约能省下6至8小时。每篇内容原本需要3至4小时，现在约需40分钟编辑。没有提供财务智能体的准确率数据。
值得了解
帖子没有说明所用工具或模型，因此你需要自行选择。她的建议是让每个智能体的任务范围保持狭窄，彼此不重叠。
亲自尝试
使用
Zapier Agents
复制提示词
为我的[副业类型]设置三个智能体。第一个研究[主题]，并将[内容类型]草稿放入[文档或文件夹]。第二个读取[收件箱]中的客户邮件、起草回复，并根据我的日历建议通话时间。第三个对[Etsy导出文件或表格]中的收入和支出分类，并编写月度摘要。每次发送邮件回复或发出日历预约之前，都暂停并展示给我。
原始来源：https://www.aimomlab.com/2026/09/the-side-hustle-stack-i-run-with-3-ai.html
